newsitem.title: USA: CSCE Dec coffee sharply lower as funds liquidate.
newsitem.headline: CSCE Dec coffee sharply lower as funds liquidate.

text.p: CSCE coffee prices traded sharply lower ahead of the close Tuesday, battered by heavy commodity fund liquidation of long positions, floor sources said.

The market took a downturn from the outset, in a technical correction to recent sharp gains. The most-active December contract has ended higher the last eight consecutive sessions, rising to near four-month highs Monday. In the month of August, December coffee has gained 24.55 cents, or about 24 percent.
At 1331 EDT, December traded down 5.70 cents, to 119.50, after ranging between 124.75 and 118.50. Spot September was 6.35 cents lower, at 130.10, while the back months were down 1.75 to 5.35.

Technically, the December contract breached support at 121.50 cents, and briefly slid through the next level at 119.00 cents, traders said. They said 115.00 cents would be the subsequent downside target.
Volume as 1300 EDT was moderate, at an estimated 6,337 lots.
